create_CogVideoXDDIMScheduler: create a CogVideoXDDIMScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and timestep spacing for video diffusion
run_set_timesteps: run set_timesteps on the CogVideoXDDIMScheduler to configure inference steps for the denoising loop
run_step_denoising: run a single denoising step with the scheduler to compute the previous sample from model output
run_add_noise: run add_noise to apply forward diffusion noise to original samples at given timesteps
create_betas_for_alpha_bar: create a beta schedule tensor using cosine, exp, or laplace alpha transform for diffusion
